courses.title: Data Visualization for Evaluators
courses.description: By the end of Data Visualization for Evaluators, you'll be able to apply data visualization confidently in Monitoring and Evaluation Specialist work, with a working sense of where programme monitoring fits alongside it. The course moves from core data visualization technique through a few applied exercises, with a lighter look at programme monitoring woven in throughout.
learning_outcomes: Applying data visualization to a real Monitoring and Evaluation Specialist scenario
Practicing data visualization through guided exercises
Getting a working introduction to programme monitoring
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

courses.title: Applying Programme Budgeting
courses.description: Applying Programme Budgeting goes beyond the basics of programme budgeting, for people already working toward a Monitoring and Evaluation Specialist role. Through a handful of applied exercises and more realistic scenarios, you'll build the kind of judgement that only comes with practice, rather than following a fixed recipe. It's built for people who already have some grounding in programme budgeting and want to go further.
learning_outcomes: Applying programme budgeting to a real Monitoring and Evaluation Specialist scenario
Practicing programme budgeting through guided exercises
